But shuttle grey. Prefer produce for safety and no tariff payment? Shuttle with tariff=0 currently — no favorable border, grey seizure 25% only. Slight edge to shuttle. Also law presidency: influence matters. Bribing to gain influence could grab presidency for round 5/6 laws. Bribe 10M gives influence 3, beating 2. But cost 10M cash for potential tax protection. Round 4 law holder is 2. Influence 3 > 2 would make me president in future rounds. Value: tax avoidance 10-20% on sales, plus veto. My sales modest. Cost 10M vs save maybe few millions. Probably not worth.

Take shuttle (choice 3).
